description: The wire contract of G9AppDiagnostic: the live channel's hub interfaces and payloads, the protocol profile, sealed envelopes and operator bundles. Shared by the gateway and the device apps.
Device diagnostics client for apps in the field: tester reports (resumable upload) to a G9AppDiagnostic gateway.

The G9AppDiagnostic gateway: devices connect to it (live channel, logs, screenshots, backups, tester reports, remote control, fleet settings); operators work in its console. Runs inside the G9Didban hub or standing alone; a product adds its own parts as extensions (IGatewayExtension).
Tester mode for .NET MAUI apps: capture panel, screen and voice recording, screenshots, gesture, timeline, drafts and a resumable send queue to a G9AppDiagnostic gateway.
Sophona Studio nodes for reading PDF files: info, text, text for LLMs, search; PDF or Word .docx as text for LLMs.
Sophona Studio utility nodes: JSON, dates, text, regex, math, hashes, IDs, validation and more. Pure computation - no network, no credentials.
